author: Hete
body:
Hey guys, 

I've come up with an idea today, which is

A Party System.

It just makes sence to me that there should be a party system in avicus.

What the Party System Could do:

• You can Create a party, then invite people to the party to join games together.

• It could also show where each other is.





That's all.

Tell me what you guys think!

title: Party System?

replies.author: ViceTechnicolour
replies.body: I just have a feeling that it's out of place and belongs more on servers such as Mineplex. I'm not saying it's a bad idea, but it certainly doesn't seem like integration of parties would be something Avicus would want to make as a move.
